what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access or dumping (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY hive or NTDS.dit extraction, suspicious access to credential stores (DPAPI, browser credential files, Credential Manager), or anomalous authentication with harvested secrets.
